frequency_question: How often does the Union government successfully issue a final mandated regulatory notification under judicial deadlines within a 10-day window?
membership_rule: Includes any instance where the Supreme Court of India has ordered the Union government to finalize and notify rules or guidelines within a specified short deadline, and the government completed the notification prior to the review hearing. Excludes general legislative enactments not tied to explicit judicial oversight deadlines.

cases.name: BS-IV to BS-VI Auto Fuel Notification Mandate (2016)
Delhi NCR Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP) Finalisation (2018)
E-Pharmacy Regulation Draft to Final Push (2019)
National Clean Air Programme Targets Notification (2021)
Online Curbs / OTT Guidelines Compliance Notification (2021)
Plastic Waste Management Amendment Rules Compliance (2022)
Data Protection Board Setup Rules Notification (2023)

coverage_note: 8 named; believed roughly 10-12 in total across comparable Supreme Court mandated health/environmental rule notifications.
known_gaps: Minor variations in bureaucratic bandwidth across different ministries are not fully captured.
skeleton: 8 named judicial-bureaucratic deadline enforcement events over 15 years involving high-salience public health and environmental rules.
validity_reason: The current judicial enforcement posture and bureaucratic responsiveness under Supreme Court monitoring remain stable through the tenure of the current administrative setup.
